apiKey.description: API key as bearer token in Authorization header. Configurable via environment variable `OPENROUTER_MANAGEMENT_KEY`.

federationPolicyId.description: ID of the organization's Workload Identity Federation policy that acts as a management key. Required with `oidcToken` or `oidcTokenFile`. Configurable via environment variable `OPENROUTER_FEDERATION_POLICY_ID`.

oidcToken.description: OIDC token issued to this workload (for example a GitLab `idTokens` JWT), exchanged for a short-lived management token through Workload Identity Federation. Use with `federationPolicyId` instead of `apiKey`. Configurable via environment variable `OPENROUTER_OIDC_TOKEN`.

oidcTokenFile.description: Path to a file holding the workload's OIDC token. The file is reread on every exchange, so a rotated token is picked up. Alternative to `oidcToken`. Configurable via environment variable `OPENROUTER_OIDC_TOKEN_FILE`.

apiKey.description: Optional partner-supplied API key with a minimum length of 32 characters and sufficient entropy. Stored as a SHA-256 hash and never returned. Requires replacement if changed.

user.description: Partner's external user identifier for attribution: 1 to 512 characters after surrounding whitespace is trimmed, well-formed Unicode, no NUL. For organization keys outside HIPAA workspaces, the value is registered as an external user if it does not exist yet, and the key is linked to it. Requires replacement if changed.

cacheRead.description: USD per cache-read prompt token, as a decimal string. When omitted, inherited from the public endpoint of the same model and provider: scaled by its cache-read to prompt ratio, or left at the pricing strategy default when it publishes no cache-read rate. Required when there is no such endpoint and the provider bills cache reads.

cacheWrite.description: USD per cache-write prompt token, as a decimal string. When omitted, inherited from the public endpoint of the same model and provider: scaled by its cache-write to prompt ratio, or left at the pricing strategy default when it publishes no cache-write rate. Required when there is no such endpoint and the provider bills cache writes.

completion.description: USD per completion token, as a decimal string. Not Null

prompt.description: USD per prompt token, as a decimal string. Not Null

contextLength.description: Longest prompt plus completion, in tokens. `null` means the model default applies.

excludedParameters.description: Request parameters the upstream rejects even though the model supports them; requests using one do not route here. Cannot name a tested parameter.

maxCompletionTokens.description: Longest completion the upstream returns, in tokens. `null` means the model default applies.

maxPromptTokens.description: Longest prompt, in tokens. `null` means no cap below the context length. Cannot exceed `contextLength`, or the model context length while `contextLength` is `null`.

quantization.description: Weight precision the deployment runs at; `unknown` when not stated. must be one of ["int4", "int8", "fp4", "mxfp4", "nvfp4", "fp6", "fp8", "mxfp8", "fp16", "bf16", "fp32", "unknown"]
